_om: Brevduen in English (The Pigeon, rusj.no/en/who-wrote-it/) – everyone secretly answers the pigeon's question, then you point at who wrote each answer. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Brevduen kommer med et spørsmål. Alle sv: The pigeon brings a question. Everyone answers in secret – then you have to guess who wrote what.
Én leser spørsmålet høyt. Så går mobilen: Someone reads the question out loud. Then the phone goes round, and each of you writes a short answer while the others look away.
Mobilen viser svarene ett for ett i tilf: The phone shows the answers one at a time in a random order. Someone reads it out, you count down, and everyone points at who they think wrote it.
Mobilen viser hvem som skrev svaret. Pek: The phone shows who wrote it. Pointed at the right person? You get 1 point. Whoever wrote the answer gets 1 point for every player they fooled.
Skriv som deg selv – eller som noen andr: Write like yourself – or like someone else. Fooling people is allowed!
Den som skrev svaret, peker også – gjern: Whoever wrote the answer points too – preferably at someone else.
Svarene blir bare på denne mobilen. De s: The answers stay on this phone. They aren't sent anywhere and are deleted as you move on.
Mobilen går rundt i samme rekkefølge som: The phone goes round in the same order as the list.
Også spørsmål for julebord og vors (18+): Add questions for office parties and pre-drinks (18+)
Brevduen har med seg et spørsmål: The pigeon has brought a question
Så går mobilen rundt, og alle skriver et: Then the phone goes round, and everyone writes an answer in secret.
De andre ser bort mens du skriver: Everyone else looks away while you write
Legg mobilen midt på bordet. Én leser sv: Put the phone in the middle of the table. Someone reads the answer out – then everyone points at once.
Les svaret høyt. Så peker alle samtidig: Read the answer out. Then everyone points at once – including whoever wrote it.
Tap everyone who pointed at the right person.
1 point for everyone who got it right.
{poeng} til {navn}, og 1 poeng til hver: {poeng} for {navn}, and 1 point for everyone who got it right.
Spill en runde, så blir det kåring!: Play a round and there'll be a winner!
Ingen klarte å lure de andre i kveld. De: Nobody managed to fool the others tonight. You know each other well!
Kveldens luring: {navn}, som lurte de an: Tonight's trickster: {navn}, who fooled the others {ganger}.
Kveldens luringer: {navn}, som lurte de: Tonight's tricksters: {navn}, who fooled the others {ganger} each.
Svarene som er skrevet, slettes. Dere ka: The answers written so far are deleted. You can always start a new one.
Svarene som er skrevet, slettes, og dere: The answers written so far are deleted, and you go straight to the results.
På nett går svarene gjennom rommet til d: Online, the answers go through the room to the other phones. The room is deleted a day after the last move at the latest.
Ditt svar! Pek på en annen, så ingen skj: That one's yours! Point at someone else so nobody twigs.
Pek på den du tror skrev det: Point at who you think wrote it
